why: A tab is store state: deep links and Back must land on the tab the user left, and global controls must reach the header from one wiring.
what: src/controls/view-tabs.tsx (2.x, on Mantine, rewritten) and src/controls/globals* (new) with tests; the overview route gets the tabs and header controls. AppShell and InnerNav are other lanes' files.
must_not_touch: contract-pins.json, MIGRATING, llms.txt, check-budgets except areas/surface.ts
contract: Read docs/v3/concepts/controls-url-state.md sections 3, 4.1, 4.3, 4.4, 5, 6, 7 and docs/v3/verdicts/control-cue.md. ViewTabs takes a ControlHandle, never value or onChange. InnerNav (v3-shell-i7a-innernav) accepts only a history 'push' handle; AppShell `globalControls` comes from v3-shell-i5-frame (an ancestor).
exemplar: Follow src/controls/control-view* (v3-ctl-4-control-view) for renderer anatomy and the cue, and src/cards/stat-card* for test layout.
change: One concern: tabs and globals. ViewTabs: handle-bound strip on ui/segmented and ui/tabs, both forms named, `only: 'sm-down'|'sm-up'` as a CSS swap with one mount each (no JS media query), inside PageAside a panel row. Prove InnerNav binds a push field (Back walks sections, items are real links). globals*: the glue and tests that make `AppShell globalControls={filterSlot([...])}` render in the header in server HTML, with a Filters (n) row sheet at compact, internal only (./controls has exactly 10 symbols). Ships: rule = control-home treats ViewTabs as a home (fixture in v3-ctl-8-lint); skill snippet = JSDoc @example on ViewTabs (generated docs/view-tabs.md); tests = view-tabs.test.tsx, view-tabs.inner-nav.test.tsx, globals.test.tsx. A new public value symbol also lands, in this Issue, its raise in scripts/check-budgets/areas/surface.ts (the ceiling +1 and a `raises` row with from, to, consumer and repo) and its name in scripts/consumers.json (`<symbol>: <repo>:<path>`); make check refuses the symbol without them. The shard is scripts/export-surface/controls.json, written by `export-surface.mjs --update`.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution; make sync-self its own commit.
proof: Layout suite on the playground overview route at 1800x1200 and 390x844 (tabs and header controls), at most 3 rounds.
acceptance: make check passes and `bun test src/controls/view-tabs src/controls/globals` is green, tests red first.
A deep link ?tab=x renders tab x on first server render, and Back returns to the previous tab (test).
Both ViewTabs forms have an accessible name (axe `label` and `button-name` clean at 390 and 1440).
globals.test.tsx: a global write on a deep link keeps the retained keys and an explicit undefined clears a retained key (the router trap suites stay in v3-ctl-2 and v3-ctl-3).

A root globalControls and a leaf PageBar controls render together; a global spec in a card slot is a @ts-expect-error. If ctl-4's spec or filterSlot typing lacks that error, file a signal on v3-ctl-4 and drop this line.
Render counts: a widget override change re-renders neither the header pill nor a memoised sibling card; changing global G re-renders only G's pill.
`git diff --name-only` lists only owned paths, the generated packages/basalt-ui/docs/view-tabs.md, and the sync-self commit.
out_of_scope: AppShell and InnerNav edits, remember-on-entry, widget overrides, FilterSet.
